findings.title: Count includes archived projects, so organizations would be overbilled
findings.explanation: The query counts every row in `projects` for the org. It has no `archived_at IS NULL` filter. Archiving a project only sets `archived_at` (see `src/routes/projects.ts:49`), and the sibling `activeProjectNames` excludes archived projects. Customers would be charged per-project for projects they archived, and the invoice would not match the project list they see. Add `AND archived_at IS NULL`, or confirm with product that archived projects are billable and document that in the comment. If the intent is to bill only active projects, the count should use the same predicate as `activeProjectNames`. Ideally both would share one definition so they cannot drift apart. Add a test with an archived project to cover this.
